answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the quartz queue while legitimate agents promoted earlier keep earning. The voyage index is deterministic from ledger replay, so that nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Admission is quota-limited: at most 631 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the mirror. Collateral of 21 dollars is at risk. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
